app.name: littleHYPE
landing.heading: One journal. Your own world.
landing.body: littleHYPE is a journal and habit tracker that lives inside a world you choose: a starship, a favourite notebook, a school of magic, or the end of the world.
landing.themes.heading: Four worlds. You choose yours after you join.
landing.themes.note: Everyone gets the same features. The world changes how it looks, sounds and feels.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
paywall.heading: Complete your purchase to continue
paywall.body: littleHYPE is a one-time purchase of $49 for lifetime access. Checkout is being connected; once your payment is confirmed you can choose your theme.
picker.heading: Choose your world
picker.intro: Pick the theme you want to journal in. Each one has its own look, language and rituals.
billing.pickerNote: This is the theme included with your purchase. It is locked to your account and cannot be changed later.
